gates.reason: Inspected SPA rendering, navigation, server-analysis loading, and untrusted labels; React escapes displayed values, no raw HTML or command execution is used, and no Claude credential/content egress is implemented here.

Re-derived flow conservation, per-tool allocation, model-entry attribution, coverage presentation, and stale-evidence labeling; displayed claims are explicitly qualified and retain their supplied evidence tier, sample, agreement, and as-of fields.
The Reclaim Compass route performs multiple full-dataset cost-attribution and flow-graph computations whose results are discarded by its later early return.
UI unit tests only render fixed local props and do not implement authentication, egress, filesystem, network, injection, or secret-handling behavior.
The test verifies coverage-state presentation and does not parse evidence, calculate recommendations, emit provenance, or provide validated fix snippets.
The small UI unit test is not production hot-path code and introduces no runtime surface or bundle dependency.

findings.title: Reclaim-only route eagerly computes the entire unused cost-attribution view
findings.what: When focusSignalId selects Reclaim Compass, the component still computes by-tool and by-project attribution, expensive sessions, and three flow graphs at lines 1863-1905, plus their downstream view models, before returning the reclaim-only tree at line 2108. These operations traverse the scoped session/tool/token dataset, including two separate calls that rebuild identical session cost rows, although none of their results appear in the returned route.
findings.fix: Split the reclaim and cost-attribution bodies into separate child components. Keep shared scoped-data calculation in the parent, branch there, and mount the full attribution child—and therefore its hooks and graph builders—only for the cost view.
findings.acceptance: Instrument or mock attributeCostByTool, attributeCostByProject, topExpensiveSessions, buildCostFlowGraph, buildSessionToolFlowGraph, and buildModelProjectFlowGraph; rendering with focusSignalId="reclaim-compass" must invoke none of them, while the normal cost view must retain existing output and conservation checks.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read src/components/CostAttribution.tsx:1858-1905 and src/components/CostAttribution.tsx:2102-2126. The expensive hooks execute before the reclaimView return, and the returned reclaim subtree consumes scopedData but none of the six derived attribution results; this is current executable behavior, not a speculative rerender concern.
